Dots = connected junctions; crossings without dots are separate wires. 12 V must never connect to UNO 5V / I/O.
A4988: MS1/MS2/MS3 + RESET/SLEEP → 5 V; 1/16 steps. Set I ≤ 0.60 A: VREF = 8 × I × Rs (read carrier Rs). Power OFF before changing motor wires.
